imageCredits.title: A boy is drawing fish on a paper.
A boy writes the address, his mother puts the stamp and he puts the letter in the postbox.
A boy is angrily stomping his feet, his mother looks confused.
A boy and his mother go to the post office.
A mailman shows the boy a robot.
A boy looks at the mailman.
A boy and his mother look at the letter while the mailman thinks.
A boy and his mother look at the mailman while he explains.
A boy, a mailman and a robot look happy.
A boy speaks to his grandmother on the phone.
A robot sorts out the mail.
